title: Agent Permission Policy
description: IAM-style permission-policy document binding one Agent Registry principal to Allow/Deny statements over namespaced actions and resources. Evaluated by scripts/agent_permission_gate.py using deny-overrides semantics.

policyId.description: Stable identifier for this policy document, conventionally pol_<agent-type-slug>.

agentType.description: Agent Registry slug from the 'Registered agent types' table, e.g. 'generalist-engineering-agent', 'architecture-agent', 'documentation-agent'.

instanceId.description: Set only when this policy narrows one specific instance rather than the whole agent type. Null means the policy applies to every instance of agentType.

sid.description: Statement identifier, unique within the policy document.

items.description: Namespaced verb, e.g. 'git:push', 'git:commit', 'github:pull_request:merge', 'github:pull_request:create', 'git:branch:delete', 'jira:issue:transition'. Destination actions are semantic and apply equally to MCP and CLI/UI fallback invocations.
ARN-like pattern, e.g. 'git:agentic-engineering-platform:branch/main', 'git:agentic-engineering-platform:branch/feature/*', 'jira:AEPI:issue/*'. A bare '*' matches every resource.

requiresHumanApproval.description: When true on an Allow statement, the gate emits an ask decision (Claude Code) or a deny-with-reason decision (Codex, where ask fails open) instead of a silent pass.

tier.description: Cross-reference to agent-assets/execution-policies/governed-repository-change.md's action tiers. Informational only; the gate does not separately enforce this field.
